Very thin edge, premium industrial tooling, restrained realistic material, no screws or circuit decoration. Compact broad geometric lettering occupying two-thirds of tile.

concepts.name: 冰透玻璃
concepts.detail: Direction: translucent optical glass monogram. A thick but controlled sculptural LIN ligature formed from frosted clear glass with subtle icy cyan and violet refraction at polished edges, seated on a thin deep midnight-blue rounded-square tile. Large restrained letterforms, clean geometric sans, translucent material with believable delicate depth. Elegant contemporary computing instrument, not sci-fi neon. Only one icon, no extra decorations.

concepts.name: 模块工作台
concepts.detail: Direction: modular architectural graphic mark for a super workbench. Vivid burnt-orange flat rounded-square tile carrying one compact black LIN typographic construction built from interlocking rectangular modules and clean orthogonal strokes, an ingenious tightly packed square composition rather than a conventional horizontal word. The L I N must remain discoverable and readable. Precision grid logic, bold balanced negative space, completely flat vector-like ink with a faint paper print tooth, no 3D.

concepts.name: 红黑时装封面
concepts.detail: Direction: radical fashion magazine cover typography distilled into an app icon. Flat saturated vermilion rounded square with enormous near-black custom LIN letters vertically stretched almost to the tile's height, very narrow condensed geometric strokes and taut dramatic negative space. Architectural typographic sculpture in two dimensions, tight editorial composition, a faint fine ink-on-uncoated-paper texture, absolutely no bevel or shine. Sophisticated experimental yet readable LIN, not the old connected lettermark.

Warm white satin ceramic rounded-square tile, LIN sculpted in low-relief raised large connected geometric lettering, only a shallow millimeter of perceived relief, extremely restrained soft side-light revealing form through fine shadows, no chrome and no glow. A serene premium instrument, subtle microceramic texture, sculptural typography with generous spacing and beautiful rounded internal transitions.

concepts.name: 石墨蚀刻
concepts.detail: Direction: dark graphite engineering tool. Matte charcoal rounded-square tile with a distinctive compact LIN monogram drawn as precisely milled thin double-line channels, subtle cool silver exposed edges and tightly spaced fine linear grooves inside broad geometric lettering. Small cyan accent only as one tiny cut within the I, not extra iconography. Ultra shallow laser engraving and fine machined texture. High precision understated high-performance visual, sharply readable silhouette, no busy circuitry or decorative panel lines.

concepts.name: 折叠铝带
concepts.detail: Direction: standalone sculptural LIN monogram with no square background tile. Build the exact letters LIN as one ingenious folded anodized-aluminum ribbon sculpture, angular L transitioning into slim I and diagonal N through elegant interlocking folds. Muted satin silver with controlled emerald green on alternate folded faces, three-dimensional but thin sheet-metal construction, clean sharp folds and soft brushed reflections. Front-facing compact square silhouette, visual depth from folds rather than inflated letters. Transparent outside the freestanding monogram, no pedestal or enclosing frame.
